task.title: Turning the System Off
task.shortdesc: If Powerwall 3 is unresponsive, it may be necessary to turn off or power cycle the system. Note that power cycling the system must be done in the proper sequence as defined below.

context.note: On Powerwall 3 systems with additional interconnected solar, always turn off the solar inverter(s) or disconnect the solar source(s) before turning off Powerwall 3.

step.cmd: Turn off Powerwall 3 by setting its On/Off switch to the OFF position.
Turn off the AC breaker to Powerwall 3.
Turn off the AC breaker to the Gateway, if installed (for whole-home backup systems, this may be a breaker inside the Gateway).
Wait for at least one hour.
Turn the AC breakers back on.
